semiconductor_relevance: High — Orbray specializes in precision-machined components and substrates critical for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly using hard-to-machine materials.
summary: Orbray Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures precision components for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-hardness materials such as diamond and sapphire. Their expertise in cutting, grinding, and polishing allows them to produce specialized substrates and products essential for semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Sapphire substrates for photonics and semiconductor use

regional_presence.Japan: Orbray has manufacturing bases in Yuzawa City, Yokote City, and Kuroishi City, primarily located in northern Japan.
